subject: CI runbook sign-off + ephemeral secret sampling plan
messages:
From: Oliver Tran <oliver.tran@brightline-sec.com>

Cc: scott.hammond@finbank.com, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: CI runbook + sampling details for SOC 2 intake

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of FinBank's SOC 2 intake we've been asked for two specific items to close the CI/CD controls section:

1) A signed (or approver-marked) CI runbook that shows the build/test/deploy flow, explicit gates, and emergency rollback paths.
2) The sampling methodology for ephemeral secrets (how often you sample, what percentage of runs are checked, and a short description of rotation/TTL enforcement).

Can you provide the docs (PDF or Drive link) and a short note that we can include in the intake packet describing who on your side owns approvals and where audit logs live? If you have a short CSV or sheet that shows the last sampling runs (anonymized is fine), that would help speed the assessor review.

No rush but FinBank's audit team would like these by end-of-week (Fri 2026-04-23). If you need us to clarify scope, loop me in.

Cheers,
Oliver
Oliver Tran
Senior Assessor, Brightline Security

Thanks for the clear list. We're preparing a runbook PDF and a sampling spreadsheet. A couple of quick clarifications before we hand things over:

Notes for internal reviewers: Kim, Jonas — can you assemble the runbook and the sampling exports (anonymized) and confirm the approver signature block? I will sign and provide the cover letter to FinBank once content is final. Target to me for review today EOD.

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: oliver.tran@brightline-sec.com
Date: 2026-04-18T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CI runbook + sampling details for SOC 2 intake

Marissa / Jonas —

Attached are three artifacts:
- CI-Runbook-v2.1.pdf (concise runbook with approval gates, step-by-step actions, rollback checklist; last updated 2026-03-30)
- ephemeral-secret-sampling-plan-2026.xlsx (sampling methodology + last 30 anonymized sampling events)
- sdlc-cover-letter-finbank.pdf (cover note summarizing owners, audit log locations, and contact points)

Quick highlights pulled into the cover letter for FinBank:
- Code review: All production merges require 2 approvers, at least one from the security org or a senior engineer with code-ownership mapping. Branch protection blocks merges until CI passes.
- CI controls: Each pipeline run emits an immutable run record to our centralized telemetry index (retained 365 days). Rollbacks are automated via tagged release artifacts with documented approval flow.
- Secrets sampling: We sample 5% of ephemeral secret lifecycles weekly (randomized) and rotate unapproved keys immediately. Sampling events include run_id, agent_id (hashed), timestamp, and rotation status; no secret material is exported.
- Approver authority: Marissa (Head of Customer Security Programs) signs external evidence; Jonas (VP, Platform) is the engineering approver for runbook technical correctness.

Jonas — I've flagged two lines in the runbook where we reference the emergency keystore rotation playbook; can you confirm the pointer and add the audit log path if different from the cover letter.

Oliver — attaching now. If you need a redacted pipeline log instead of the sheet, say the word and we can produce that within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CI-Runbook-v2.1.pdf; ephemeral-secret-sampling-plan-2026.xlsx; sdlc-cover-letter-finbank.pdf

Subject: Re: Request: CI runbook + sampling details for SOC 2 intake

Oliver / Scott —

Attached are the requested artifacts. Summary:
- Runbook: CI-Runbook-v2.1.pdf (signed by me in the approver block; Jonas confirmed technical pointers)
- Sampling: ephemeral-secret-sampling-plan-2026.xlsx (30-day anonymized sample, methodology tab + sampling events tab)
- Cover letter: sdlc-cover-letter-finbank.pdf (owners, audit log locations, retention windows, contact details)

We don't include raw secrets or private key material in any export — the sampling file explicitly contains no secret values. Our audit logs for pipeline runs are retained for 365 days and are accessible to assessors under NDA; if FinBank requires on-prem viewing or a remote session to examine logs, we can schedule a 1-hour session with our platform engineering team next week.

Doc links and signature: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcD_example_runbook (runbook), DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/12345/FinBank-SDLCRunbook (approver record).

If this addresses your needs please confirm; otherwise tell us which artifacts you prefer redacted or reformatted and we'll follow up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference
